items.title: Leon Rene Interview, 1979-05-07
items.q: The mention of 'baby Alba' is part of a story told by the INTERVIEWER about his uncle, not a personal relationship of the interviewee.

ctx.x: And I have a nephew name. That's all. Theophilus. Well, when my uncle was born, his father saw him and said, that's Theophilus-looking baby Alba. No, my uncle was the in man. Yeah, yeah. And so he always had bad jokes. Let's get your date back.
Is he going to talk over here?
